title: Onboarding and settings invite flows share inviteLogic
answers: What must stay consistent between onboarding and settings invite flows?
Where does onboarding recompute invite validity?
body:
Both `OnboardingInviteTeammates` (frontend/src/scenes/onboarding/legacy/OnboardingInviteTeammates.tsx) and settings `InviteModal` use `inviteLogic` and `InviteTeamMatesComponent` (InviteModal.tsx), and call the same invites/bulk/ endpoint.
- `canSubmit` in inviteLogic is the single validity rule set; onboarding recomputes parts (hasInvalidEmail, owner confirmation, fill-all-fields) for `continueDisabledReason`. Changing canSubmit requires updating that too.
- Hard-coded "3 days" expiry copy appears in InviteModal and OnboardingInviteTeammates; must match `INVITE_DAYS_VALIDITY` in posthog/constants.
- `MAX_INVITES_AT_ONCE` (client) must match the server cap of 20 in `bulk`.
- Name/message fields only shown when `preflight.email_service_available`.
applies: Changes to invite form rules, limits, or copy.
says: Teammate invites during signup say different things than the settings invite screen.
I tried to invite 25 people but only 20 were sent.
Invite expiration copy should match between signup flow and team settings.
Both onboarding and settings should enforce the same teammate invite rules.
The invite limit works differently in signup versus the settings menu.
search: Onboarding and settings invite flows share inviteLogic as the single validity rule across both UI surfaces. Changes to canSubmit in inviteLogic (frontend/src/scenes/settings/organization/inviteLogic.ts) must be synchronized with onboarding's continueDisabledReason in OnboardingInviteTeammates.tsx, as both call the same invites/bulk/ endpoint. The hard-coded "3 days" expiry copy in InviteModal.tsx and OnboardingInviteTeammates.tsx must match the server constant INVITE_DAYS_VALIDITY in posthog/constants, and the client-side MAX_INVITES_AT_ONCE limit (20) must match the server cap in OrganizationInviteViewSet.bulk. Name and message fields are conditionally shown only when preflight.email_service_available is true. Task applies to: changes to invite form rules, validation limits, or UI copy affecting both flows.
